entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: N-Not like I'm freakin' out or anything...[n]H-Haha, no way...
entries.uk: Н-не те щоб я панікував...[n]Х-ха-ха, та ні...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ain't there some kinda hole we can get[n]through...?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: These bars're tougher than they look...
The metal bars feel cold to the touch...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What time is it now?[n]Ain't it still mornin'?
entries.uk: Котра зараз година?[n]Ще ж ранок, хіба ні?

entries.en: It's in tatters... I would like to avoid using[n]it at all costs...
entries.uk: Суцільне лахміття... Хотілося б[n]нізащо цим не користуватися...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Like, somewhere we could kick and bust[n]the wall down? Dammit... It's no use...
entries.uk: Ну, такої, щоб копнути й розвалити[n]стіну? Трясця... Марно...

entries.en: There are no cracks in sight...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Those freakin' chains... At least we can[n]move now...
There's a somewhat dull sheen[n]to these shackles...
It seems this barrel is empty...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, should we hide in here and trick[n]the guards?
entries.uk: Слухай, може, сховаємося тут[n]і обдуримо вартових?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, are there even any guards[n]'round here...?
entries.uk: Стоп, а тут узагалі є[n]якісь вартові...?

entries.en: It's emitting a pungent, foul odor...[n]It seems like there's something[n]inside here...
entries.uk: Звідти тхне чимось їдким і гидким...[n]Схоже, всередині[n]щось є...
